# Freenary

> Freenary is a self-hosted, open-source personal finance app (AGPL-3.0-or-later). It runs as four Docker Compose services (postgres, migrate, server, web), connects to banks through Powens or Enable Banking, and stores everything in PostgreSQL. The web app on port 3001 forwards /api/auth, /rpc, /ai/chat and /api-reference to the API server, so a deployment has one public address. Only POSTGRES_PASSWORD and BETTER_AUTH_SECRET are required to start; the first account to sign in becomes the operator.

Every page is plain Markdown.

## Tutorials

- [Get it running](tutorials/get-it-running.md): start the stack locally with Docker Compose, verify it, create the operator account
- [Self-host on a server](tutorials/self-host-on-a-server.md): domain, HTTPS with Caddy, WEB_PORT and TRUSTED_PROXIES
- [Connect your first bank](tutorials/connect-your-first-bank.md): finish the setup screen with a Powens sandbox
